title: Held-out examples by omission; the lead hands them to reviewers
situation: Raised by the lead realizing intent-based delegation, 2026-10-15. The lead dispatches each reviewer but the record did not say who gives a reviewer the story's held-out examples, nor where new ones are kept.
decision: Held-out examples are kept with the design, apart from the visible examples. The lead, who dispatches the reviewers, gives a story's held-out examples to its reviewers and to no one else; it never names them in a task, and a failing one reaches a builder only as its concept and the shortfall. No mechanism prevents reading them and no instruction forbids it, because a prohibition would announce them. Where exactly they are kept is the lead's choice.
consequences: The held-out example concept states this.
